# Video script: Rate and rhythm in one minute of scanning

> DRAFT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Contains claims with status 'ai-cross-checked' that no clinician has verified.

Unit D8 | Target length: 4 min

| # | Shot | Narration | Claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Four-chamber clip, normal rhythm, with rate displayed | At screening, assess rate and regularity on the four-chamber view. One-twenty to one-sixty beats per minute, and regular. | IS23-033 |
| 2 | Clip with an occasional early beat and a pause | A skipped beat now and then is the commonest rhythm finding. It is often benign and often settles. But count them. | IS23-034, IS23-035 |
| 3 | Graphic: counting beats between pauses | Ectopic beats more often than every three to five beats need further assessment. So does a rhythm that stays irregular for more than one to two weeks. | IS23-035 |
| 4 | Clip: rate slowing briefly, then recovering | A brief slow rate that goes with probe pressure is seen in normal second-trimester fetuses. A rate that stays at one-ten or below in a well fetus needs timely review by a fetal cardiac specialist. | IS23-036 |
| 5 | Clip of a fast regular rhythm with rate displayed | A brief rise to between one-sixty and one-eighty with movement can be a normal variant. A rate that stays at one-eighty or above needs further evaluation. | IS23-037 |
